# E120 -- Habitat

## Metadata
- **Brand**: Habitat
- **Industry**: Home Retail / Furniture & Home Furnishings
- **Document**: Brand Identity Manual ("Brand Book TEXT artwork 7.3.02")
- **Year**: 2002 (issued April 2002; PDF created 2006)
- **Pages**: 15
- **Designer/Agency**: Not credited (produced by Inter Habitat AG, Baar, Switzerland)

## Brand Strategy
- Habitat positions itself as a home furnishings brand "for people who love their home." The symbol mark represents "the concept of a heart within the home."
- The wordmark dates back to 1964 (Terence Conran era); the symbol mark was introduced in 2002 to provide a legally registrable identity.
- Two palette systems (Corporate and Seasonal) keep store environments feeling "fresh and innovative" while maintaining a consistent corporate backbone.

## Logo
- **Primary mark**: Standard Mark -- wordmark + symbol mark used together (preferred).
- **Variants**: Stacked Mark, Symbol-only Mark, Small Word Mark, Small Symbol-only Mark.
- Wordmark must never appear without the symbol mark.
- Positive and negative versions supplied; negative reversed out of black or authorised colour with full-bleed background.
- Minimum size: Standard Mark no smaller than 30 mm wide; Symbol-only no smaller than 15 mm; Small Symbol-only no smaller than 3 mm.
- Freezone calculated as 1/3 of symbol width on all sides.
- Extensive Do's and Don'ts: no recolouring segments, no boxing, no bleeding marks off-edge, no rearranging elements, no outlining, no use in running text as a glyph.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface**: DIN Habitat -- a custom variant of DIN in three weights:
  - DIN Habitat Regular (any size)
  - DIN Habitat Bold (36pt and below)
  - DIN Habitat Headline (large display sizes)
- Leading: 115-120% of point size; detailed leading table provided (6pt-72pt).
- Tracking: no overall adjustment; individual kerning allowed.
- Word spacing: min 85, optimum 110, max 250; character spacing min 0, optimum 0, max 4.
- Paragraphs indicated by line space (no indentation).
- "Habitat" in running text: always lowercase with uppercase H; never all caps, never all lowercase.
- **Utility font**: Habitat Utility Font containing arrows (Regular and Bold weights) and architectural door symbols.

## Color
- **Corporate Palette**: PANTONE Process Black, PANTONE Warm Grey 5c, and white.
- **Seasonal Palettes**: Issued per season (Spring/Summer, Autumn/Winter, Christmas, Sale) by the Brand Manager; supplemented with black and white. Examples shown as "Season X/Y/Z" placeholder swatches.
- Mark may appear on unprinted natural-material backgrounds (unbleached brown papers/boards, transparent/frosted plastic, embossed/debossed into product material).

## Graphics
- Symbol mark (heart-in-home icon) is the primary graphic device.
- No additional graphic elements or patterns described beyond the mark system and utility font icons (arrows, door symbols).

## Photography
- Not covered in this manual. Mark placement over photographic backgrounds addressed: position in areas of little tonal variation; ensure symbol interior remains transparent (never opaque).

## Applications
- **Corporate**: business stationery, press office stationery, delivery vehicles, gift vouchers, wedding list, Habitat Card communications, art programme.
- **Seasonal**: POS schemes (Summer, A/W, Christmas), seasonal carrier bags, lookbook, press invitations/releases, CD-ROM, seasonal customer mailings, staff training ("Source").
- **Store environment**: directional signage, core carrier bags, till-point graphics, product packaging, ticketing, product information.
- **Website**: corporate (non-seasonal pages) and seasonal pages distinguished.

## Tone of Voice
- Not explicitly covered. The manual itself uses a precise, instructional tone. Brand positioning language suggests warmth, modernity, and understated elegance.

## Outliers
- Very early digital-era document (QuarkXPress 6.0, 2002/2006); landscape-oriented spread layout at 1570 x 595 pts.
- Heart-within-home symbol mark has a notable origin story (anagram of "Tabitha," the Conran family cat).
- Utility font with architectural symbols is unusual for a retail brand identity system.
- Seasonal palette system is deliberately undefined in the manual -- swatches must be obtained from the Brand Manager each season, keeping the guide evergreen.

## Quality Score
3 / 5
Solid foundational identity manual covering logo, colour, and type thoroughly, but lacks photography direction, tone of voice, and digital/motion guidelines. The seasonal palette system is intentionally open-ended, which limits standalone utility. Clean and well-structured for its era.
